title: Configuration Validity Encoding Length
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $Q$, and let $C,n,s$ be natural numbers. Write $A=|Q|+6k+5$ and $B=3(|Q|+1)^2+(|Q|+1)+9+21k$; assume $A\le C$. The serialized configuration-validity CNF for parameters $C,n,s$ has length at most $(3B+7)C^2(s+n+2)^3$.
caveat: The supplied definitions do not give informal descriptions of the validity CNF or its padding, so the construction is identified only by its stated role.
